brief.why: Get from a closed game to the key bindings page, and picture every page of it, so the controls are known without asking.
brief.start: Game closed. Claude launches it and says LISTENING; press nothing before that.
move: Same screens as the gameplay route until the main menu: Page Up / Page Down on each, as before.
From the main menu, go to the key bindings page the quickest way (OPTIONS, then the keyboard or controls page).
On EACH page of bindings, press Page Down once (that saves the picture). If the list scrolls, Page Up, then the scroll key, and Page Down on the next page.
brief.screen: The whole bindings list, one page at a time.
brief.avoid: Changing any binding. Back out without saving if the game asks.

controls.source: Prototype key bindings page, read 2026-09-29 (default keyboard + mouse)
controls.free_for_mods: the number pad (no binding uses it); F1-F11 are game powers
